root_cause.text: `rockchip_usb2phy_probe()` in `drivers/phy/rockchip/phy-rockchip-inno-usb2.c` double-released a device tree child node (`child_np`) because `for_each_available_child_of_node()` already drops the reference, but the error path after a failed `devm_request_threaded_irq()` still jumped to `put_child` and called `of_node_put()` again.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description says “`for_each_available_child_of_node()` calls `of_node_put()` to release `child_np` in each success loop” and that after breaking from the loop “the code will jump to the `put_child` label and will call the `of_node_put()` again if the `devm_request_threaded_irq()` fails”; the patch fixes this by changing `goto put_child;` to `return ret;`, removing the duplicate `of_node_put()`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Return the IRQ request error directly from probe instead of falling through to the child cleanup path.
intent_record.what: In `rockchip_usb2phy_probe()`, the error path after `dev_err_probe()` was changed from `goto put_child;` to `return ret;` when requesting the usb2phy IRQ handle fails.
intent_record.how: On failure to obtain the IRQ handle, the function now exits immediately with the error code instead of jumping to the `put_child` cleanup path. This changes the probe failure flow by skipping the remaining cleanup sequence associated with that label.

grouping_result.intent: Return the IRQ request error directly from probe instead of falling through to the child cleanup path.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly addresses the reported double-release bug by avoiding the erroneous jump to the child cleanup path after `devm_request_threaded_irq()` fails, preventing the extra `of_node_put()` on `child_np`.

candidates.rationale: This jump sends the probe failure path to the child-node cleanup label even though the child was iterated with for_each_available_child_of_node(), which already drops the reference. That leads directly to a second of_node_put() on child_np and causes the double-release.

vuln_statements.explanation: This jump routes the devm_request_threaded_irq() failure path into the child-node cleanup label even though child_np was obtained via for_each_available_child_of_node(), which already releases the reference. Hitting put_child from this error path causes an extra of_node_put() and double-releases the device tree node.
